art_direction: 奶油黄底，左眼大而更开，双眼回头般左望，轻微惊讶。
composition_variation: Make the left larger and higher, open to two-thirds height; right is a shorter half-open curve. Turn both pupils left for a second look. Keep the pupils generous and attached to the lids to avoid wide-eyed staring. Unequal openings convey mild thoughtful surprise. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
